contentPattern.structure: two dissimilar side-by-side cells (e.g. data/stat widget + featured article promo)

suitableFor: two heterogeneous panels side-by-side on a light background
stat/ticker widget paired with a featured article or promo
general two-up informational layouts with a CTA per side
notSuitableFor: uniform repeating card grids (use a cards variant)
full-bleed background-image banners (use a hero variant)
